verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה רְאֵ֛ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְפַרְעֹ֑ה אָחִ֖יךָ וְאַהֲרֹ֥ן יִהְיֶ֥ה נְבִיאֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·yō·mer mō·šeh rə·’êh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·’a·hă·rōn yih·yeh nə·ḇî·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD . . . answered Moses See I have made you like God to Pharaoh and your brother Aaron will be your prophet

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תְדַבֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אָחִ֙יךָ֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֤ן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯə·ḏab·bêr ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·we·kā ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·’a·hă·rōn yə·ḏab·bêr ’el- par·‘ōh bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- mê·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: You are to speak - all that I command you and your brother Aaron is to tell - Pharaoh to let the Israelites . . . go - out of his land

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י אַקְשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה לֵ֣ב וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י אֶת־ אֹתֹתַ֛י וְאֶת־ מוֹפְתַ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’aq·šeh ’eṯ- par·‘ōh lêḇ wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ō·ṯō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- mō·wp̄·ṯay bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But I will harden - Pharaoh’s heart and though I will multiply - My signs - and wonders in the land of Egypt

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַ֤ע אֲלֵכֶם֙ וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ יָדִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם גְּדֹלִֽים׃ בִּשְׁפָטִ֖ים וְהוֹצֵאתִ֨י אֶת־ צִבְאֹתַ֜י אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh wə·lō- yiš·ma‘ ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî bə·miṣ·rā·yim gə·ḏō·lîm biš·p̄ā·ṭîm wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯay ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh will not listen to you Then I will lay - My hand on Egypt and by mighty acts of judgment I will bring - the divisions - of My people the Israelites . . . out of the land of Egypt

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ וְיָדְע֤וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בִּנְטֹתִ֥י אֶת־ יָדִ֖י עַל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוֹצֵאתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִתּוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ra·yim wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bin·ṭō·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘al- miṣ·rā·yim wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mit·tō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I stretch out - My hand against Egypt and bring - the Israelites . . . out from among them

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה אֹתָ֖ם צִוָּ֧ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·ya·‘aś kên ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD - had commanded them

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁה֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַֽהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּדַבְּרָ֖ם אֶל־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh šə·mō·nîm ben- šā·nāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ben- šā·lōš ū·šə·mō·nîm šā·nāh bə·ḏab·bə·rām ’el- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: Moses was eighty years old . . . and Aaron . . . was eighty-three . . . . . . when they spoke to Pharaoh

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: The LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .

verses.original: כִּי֩ פַּרְעֹה֙ יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵכֶ֤ם לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנ֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם מוֹפֵ֑ת וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֧ח אֶֽת־ מַטְּךָ֛ וְהַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי־ פַרְעֹ֖ה יְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: kî par·‘ōh yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·ḵem lê·mōr tə·nū lā·ḵem mō·w·p̄êṯ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭə·ḵā wə·haš·lêḵ lip̄·nê- p̄ar·‘ōh yə·hî lə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: When Pharaoh tells you . . . Perform a miracle you are to say . . . to Aaron Take - your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh [and] it {will} become a serpent

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וַיָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַשׂוּ כֵ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָ֑ה צִוָּ֣ה אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ וַיַּשְׁלֵ֨ךְ מַטֵּ֗הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֛ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·yā·ḇō ’el- par·‘ōh way·ya·ʿa·śū ḵên ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- way·yaš·lêḵ maṭ·ṭê·hū lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh wə·lip̄·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·hî lə·ṯan·nîn
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did . . . just as the LORD had commanded Aaron - threw his staff {down} before Pharaoh . . . and his officials and it became a serpent

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֔ה גַּם־ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַֽחֲכָמִ֖ים וְלַֽמְכַשְּׁפִ֑ים חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם הֵ֜ם גַם־ וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֨וּ כֵּֽן׃ בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh gam- way·yiq·rā la·ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·lam·ḵaš·šə·p̄îm ḥar·ṭum·mê miṣ·ra·yim hêm ḡam- way·ya·‘ă·śū kên bə·la·hă·ṭê·hem
verses.literal: But Pharaoh called the wise men and sorcerers and magicians of Egypt and they also did the same things by their magic arts

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ וַיַּשְׁלִ֙יכוּ֙ מַטֵּ֔הוּ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְתַנִּינִ֑ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶת־ מַטֵּֽה־ וַיִּבְלַ֥ע מַטֹּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš way·yaš·lî·ḵū maṭ·ṭê·hū way·yih·yū lə·ṯan·nî·nim ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭêh- way·yiḇ·la‘ maṭ·ṭō·ṯām
verses.literal: Each one threw down his staff and it became a serpent But Aaron’s - staff swallowed up [the other] staffs

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֔ה לֵ֣ב וַיֶּחֱזַק֙ וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃פ דִּבֶּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh lêḇ way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber
verses.literal: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not listen to them just as the LORD had said

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה פַּרְעֹ֑ה לֵ֣ב כָּבֵ֖ד מֵאֵ֖ן הָעָֽם׃ לְשַׁלַּ֥ח
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh par·‘ōh lêḇ kā·ḇêḏ mê·’ên hā·‘ām lə·šal·laḥ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Pharaoh’s heart [is] unyielding he refuses to let the people go

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֞ה בַּבֹּ֗קֶר הִנֵּה֙ יֹצֵ֣א הַמַּ֔יְמָה וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ עַל־ שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֑ר לִקְרָאת֖וֹ תִּקַּ֥ח בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃ וְהַמַּטֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְנָחָ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: lêḵ ’el- par·‘ōh bab·bō·qer hin·nêh yō·ṣê ham·may·māh wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr liq·rā·ṯōw tiq·qaḥ bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer- neh·paḵ lə·nā·ḥāš
verses.literal: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעִבְרִים֙ שְׁלָחַ֤נִי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עַמִּ֔י שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ וְיַֽעַבְדֻ֖נִי בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַד־ כֹּֽה׃ לֹא־ שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr ‘am·mî šal·laḥ ’eṯ- wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî bam·miḏ·bār wə·hin·nêh ‘aḏ- kōh lō- šā·ma‘·tā
verses.literal: Then say to him The LORD the God of the Hebrews has sent me . . . to tell you Let My people go - so that they may worship Me in the wilderness But until now you have not listened

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר בְּזֹ֣את תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֨ה בַּמַּטֶּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּיָדִ֗י אָנֹכִ֜י מַכֶּ֣ה׀ הַמַּ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיְאֹ֖ר עַל־ וְנֶהֶפְכ֥וּ לְדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar bə·zōṯ tê·ḏa‘ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh hin·nêh bam·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer- bə·yā·ḏî ’ā·nō·ḵî mak·keh ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer bay·’ōr ‘al- wə·ne·hep̄·ḵū lə·ḏām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says By this you will know that I am the LORD Behold with the staff - in my hand I will strike the water - of the Nile . . . and it will turn to blood

verses.original: וְהַדָּגָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֛ר תָּמ֖וּת הַיְאֹ֑ר וּבָאַ֣שׁ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִלְא֣וּ לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מִן־ הַיְאֹֽר׃ס מַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·ḡāh ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr tā·mūṯ hay·’ōr ū·ḇā·’aš miṣ·ra·yim wə·nil·’ū liš·tō·wṯ min- hay·’ōr ma·yim
verses.literal: The fish - in the Nile will die the river will stink and the Egyptians will be unable to drink vvv its water

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֣ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֡ן קַ֣ח מַטְּךָ֣ וּנְטֵֽה־ יָדְךָ֩ עַל־ מֵימֵ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם עַֽל־ נַהֲרֹתָ֣ם׀ עַל־ יְאֹרֵיהֶ֣ם וְעַל־ אַגְמֵיהֶ֗ם וְעַ֛ל כָּל־ מֵימֵיהֶ֖ם מִקְוֵ֥ה וְיִֽהְיוּ־ דָ֑ם וְהָ֤יָה דָם֙ בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבָעֵצִ֖ים וּבָאֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn qaḥ maṭ·ṭə·ḵā ū·nə·ṭêh- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- mê·mê miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- na·hă·rō·ṯām ‘al- yə·’ō·rê·hem wə·‘al- ’aḡ·mê·hem wə·‘al kāl- mê·mê·hem miq·wêh wə·yih·yū- ḏām wə·hā·yāh ḏām bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇā·‘ê·ṣîm ū·ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses Tell . . . Aaron Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt over their rivers . . . [and] canals . . . and ponds and all vvv the reservoirs that they may become blood There will be blood throughout the land of Egypt even in the vessels of wood and stone

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאַהֲרֹ֜ן וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֩ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ יְהוָ֗ה צִוָּ֣ה לְעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיָּ֤רֶם בַּמַּטֶּה֙ וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּיְאֹ֔ר כָּל־ הַמַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֖ר וַיֵּהָֽפְכ֛וּ לְדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh lə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·lə·‘ê·nê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yā·rem bam·maṭ·ṭeh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer bay·’ōr kāl- ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr way·yê·hā·p̄ə·ḵū lə·ḏām
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron did . . . just as the LORD had commanded in the presence of Pharaoh . . . and his officials [Aaron] raised the staff and struck - the water - of the Nile and all the water - - was turned to blood

verses.original: וְהַדָּגָ֨ה אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיְאֹ֥ר מֵ֙תָה֙ הַיְאֹ֔ר וַיִּבְאַ֣שׁ מִצְרַ֔יִם יָכְל֣וּ וְלֹא־ לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מִן־ הַיְאֹ֑ר מַ֖יִם וַיְהִ֥י הַדָּ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·had·dā·ḡāh ’ă·šer- bay·’ōr mê·ṯāh hay·’ōr way·yiḇ·’aš miṣ·ra·yim yā·ḵə·lū wə·lō- liš·tō·wṯ min- hay·’ōr ma·yim way·hî had·dām bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The fish - in the Nile died and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink vvv its water And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt

verses.original: חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵ֛ן בְּלָטֵיהֶ֑ם פַּרְעֹה֙ לֵב־ וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃ דִּבֶּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ḥar·ṭum·mê miṣ·ra·yim way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·lā·ṭê·hem par·‘ōh lêḇ- way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber
verses.literal: But the magicians of Egypt did the same things by their magic arts So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened and he would not listen to [Moses and Aaron] just as the LORD had said

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיִּ֣פֶן וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥ת גַּם־ לָזֹֽאת׃ לִבּ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yi·p̄en way·yā·ḇō ’el- bê·ṯōw wə·lō- šāṯ gam- lā·zōṯ lib·bōw
verses.literal: Instead, Pharaoh turned around went into his palace and did not take any of this to heart

verses.original: כָל־ מִצְרַ֛יִם וַיַּחְפְּר֧וּ סְבִיבֹ֥ת הַיְאֹ֖ר מַ֣יִם לִשְׁתּ֑וֹת כִּ֣י יָֽכְלוּ֙ לֹ֤א לִשְׁתֹּ֔ת מִמֵּימֵ֖י הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim way·yaḥ·pə·rū sə·ḇî·ḇōṯ hay·’ōr ma·yim liš·tō·wṯ kî yā·ḵə·lū lō liš·tōṯ mim·mê·mê hay·’ōr
verses.literal: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink because they could not drink the water from the river

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַיִּמָּלֵ֖א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הַכּוֹת־ הַיְאֹֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm way·yim·mā·lê ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh ’eṯ- hak·kō·wṯ- hay·’ōr
verses.literal: And seven full days passed after the LORD - had struck the Nile
